items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Dud used to, everytime he'd go there, he and Sam Taylor, told me about Japan.

ctx.x: Dud used to come back and tell me, he'd say Hawk, you've got to go. He said the people keep asking about you over there. You know? And I said perhaps one of these days, you know, like that.
